algebra.recover: Re-run the same hop after fix. Never waive and proceed.
algebra.reports: Harness-generated only. Bound to this package_dir + input file hashes. Prerequisite reports need non-empty checks that match a live hop re-run (id+PASS stubs are REJECT). Prerequisite ACCEPT is decideVerdict(checks); the self-certified verdict field is not trusted. Any P0 FAIL in checks is prereq REJECT. Forged, grafted, empty-check, or stale reports are REJECT. R3 re-scans current CV/CL/Brief/Profile HTML and independently re-verifies VI provenance; disk ACCEPT cannot waive those gates. Supervisors must --verify (or a fresh --hop R3) before ATS fill; a disk R3.json verdict is never sufficient. --verify re-runs R3 live, re-derives decideVerdict, and REJECTs missing, handwritten, or disk-vs-live disagreement.

hops.name: Brief
hops.notes: Brief YAML locks page composition: selected_work_ids lead-first plus page_slots (archetype, lead, second, supporting, omit). Missing slots or a P-led agency film-only lead while ads/reel ids are listed is REJECT. First viewport is the lead work as a frame (real video or INDEX public:true still). A lead id with no real video (Vimeo ok) and no INDEX public:true still is REJECT (STOP) — uncatalogued fixture files and invented frames are not lead assets. Later hops may not substitute another category (film for ads).

hops.name: VI distill
hops.notes: VI distill needs source URL + date + exact hex/font/radius AND usage notes. Token-only hex/font is REJECT. R-VI gates the rendered page, not notes in vi.json: a fat brand-color document header fails even if usage notes say field/wordmark. Thin ≤56px chrome (may be primary) and/or a later primary field that is not the first-80px header is the pass path. Tiny labels still fail. When HTML is present, the first viewport must be a work frame. When HTML is absent, a chrome-only Giant Spoon distill is still REJECT (work/case content must be in the record). Home hero type-only white is chrome, not the brand.

hops.name: Profile
hops.notes: Qualifying live evidence required: HTTP 2xx AND body contains dedicated-profile path identity (/{slug}/ or ai.drsfilms.com/{slug}). Company-word mention alone is not enough. Local profile.html alone is REJECT. SPA 200 empty shell is FAIL. --fetch-profile 4xx/5xx/timeout/error is FAIL. Self-test may inject fetchResult. When --fetch-profile succeeds, profile content gates judge the live body; a stale local exam HTML (old 78vh spacer) must not AND-fail R2/R3 if live would PASS. Local-only runs (no fetch) still judge local HTML. First viewport is the Brief lead as a frame: real video (Vimeo ok) or INDEX public:true still, filling the capped work column after ≤56px chrome. Wordmark is thin chrome, not a résumé masthead (role + location in a fat brand-color header). A solid brand-color type slab (heading + paragraph, no media) is not a work slot. Uncatalogued fixture files and invented frames are not lead assets. Work column capped min(1120px, calc(100% - 40px)) (1080–1240); 100vw work img/iframe/video is REJECT (wordmark/nav may be full row). Picture/video fills the column, not the viewport. compared_to is this company's official work/case pages (external https URLs on the VI source host) — never our live portfolio, never our /wonder/ route, never a timestamp type-wall bar. Profile HTML must contain real work stills; text-only / empty / placeholder is REJECT. Hung files require assets.json external_ready:true AND INDEX public:true. 58-node file only on /wonder/ until generic public. DEV4 UIs are public:false. Visible A-* ids REJECT. Also REJECT token-only VI, text-only showreel cards, legal-paragraph credits, and JD-archetype invocation misses. First viewport / first work row must match Brief page_slots.lead. P-led ads Brief whose first viewport is a FILM PRODUCER / film-slate wordmark fighting advertising showreel is REJECT. P-led AI film stills that dominate ads lead frames are REJECT. First-viewport screenshot compare is a supervisor check, not CI Playwright; HTML heuristics stand in.

hops.name: Closeout
hops.notes: ACCEPT means CV + CL + a real company Profile exist and match this package now, with qualifying live evidence (2xx + dedicated-profile path identity). Prior reports must be harness-generated, bound, fresh, and reproduce live hop evidence (not id+PASS stubs). R3 independently re-runs claim-lock, slop, skip-language, waiver, and R-VI provenance on current files. Supervisor --verify re-runs this hop live and re-derives decideVerdict; missing, handwritten, or disagreeing disk R3.json is REJECT.

profile_url.evidence: qualifying live HTTP 2xx whose body contains dedicated-profile path identity (/{slug}/ or ai.drsfilms.com/{slug}); company-word mention alone is not enough; local HTML alone is not enough; SPA 200 empty shell is FAIL
